As the mission need is further explored, realization of a true three-axis radiographic test facility would present significant advantages over a dual-axis capability. Dynamic Thermal Testing at DARHT The development of a DARHT capability to simulate, mock- up, or reproduce dynamic thermal conditions during a hydrodynamic experiment would be transformative. A few potential methods will be explored for viability including: (1) inductive heating; (2) direct high-power laser heating; (3) direct electron beam heating provided by either DARHT axis; and (4) alternative particle heating sources (x-rays and/or neutrons).
